summary: Pebblebrook Hotel Trust filed an 8-K reporting the sale of the 115-room Chamberlain West Hollywood Hotel in Los Angeles, CA, for $43.5 million to a third party, closing on May 27, 2026. The price reflects gross proceeds from a single property sale; no per-share price, premium, or advisor is stated. Proceeds will be used for debt reduction, preferred equity paydown, opportunistic share repurchases, and other capital allocation priorities. The sale is a straightforward asset divestiture with no special terms or regulatory clock noted. Watch for further hotel dispositions or capital return updates as part of Pebblebrook's portfolio optimization.
